card.name: St. John's Wort and enzyme inducers
card.fires_on: The last part of "St. John's Wort", of "inducers" (CYP3A4 inducers), and of "rifampin" in drug-interaction text. It fires on the word ending that completes these inducer names.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated word pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the end of names for drugs and herbs that speed up drug breakdown, like St. John's Wort, rifampin and CYP3A4 inducers.
